blog.title: PassGen Pro: passwords you'll never have to remember
blog.description: Generate strong random passwords or memorable passphrases, with a strength meter and one-click copy.

body.text: Most passwords are weak because humans have to invent and remember them. PassGen Pro removes the human from that job.
It generates strong passwords with your browser's secure random generator. Pick random characters or a memorable passphrase. A strength meter scores every result by entropy, and one click copies it.

items: Random: 8 to 64 characters from the sets you choose
Passphrase: 3 to 8 common words joined with dashes — easy to type, hard to crack
Optional filter for ambiguous characters like 1, l, and 0
Generate, check the strength meter, copy

body.text: Your last 10 passwords stay in a private history in the open tab. Click any of them to copy it again. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
PassGen Pro is $6 a month, or $30 for six months. Pay the admin, request your unlock PIN, and the tool opens up for your whole subscription.
